purpose: Independent measurement of stable content and native APC recovery, not recovery or fitting of the original Table I
source_selection: Distinct source groups, SHA256(seed:source) order after explicit prior-source exclusions; take first 25/family before tokenizer capacity checks; do not replace excluded or failed selections
cache_protocol: Native vLLM 0.10.2 APC; reset before every source session, retain within its ten turns; one active request per process; no ContractKV compilation or certification
history: Previous question-only user messages and actual generated assistant texts; retrieved documents are not duplicated into history; retain all previous turns without truncation
packing: Existing label-blind task-fidelity head/tail packing of optional context; preserve system, question and complete CODE_PREFIX; pack once per source with worst-case history allowance, then freeze context for all turns; retain capacity exclusions without replacement
history_allowance: 9 * (largest wrapped-question token count + 64 output tokens + 32 chat-framing tokens) + 256 boundary tokens
QA_current_user_order: Original context segments followed by the wrapped question; original system text is a separate system message
RepoBench_current_user_order: Wrapped task instruction, repository context, complete CODE_PREFIX last
QA_system_suffix: Give only a concise answer, without explanation.
RepoBench_system: Complete Python code using the supplied repository context. Output only the next line, without explanations or fences.
token_attribution: Exact fast-tokenizer character offsets over the complete chat rendering; only tokens fully inside declared stable body spans are stable. Chat controls, segment headings and boundary-crossing tokens are framing, not stable body.
primary_population: Future turns 1-9; turn 0 and all-business turns separately reported
rho_s: Sum of stable body tokens / sum of all actual prompt tokens
rho_p: Sum of stable body tokens within actual native cached prefix / sum of stable body tokens
auxiliary_metric: All native cached tokens / all prompt tokens, explicitly distinct from rho_p
aggregation: Token-pooled ratios per family; unweighted mean of five family ratios and global token-pooled ratios separately; source-macro ratios separately
uncertainty: 2000 source-cluster bootstrap draws within each family with seed 20261018, keeping all repetitions and turns of each selected source together
retain: Every selected source, capacity exclusion, request, full prompt IDs/text, output IDs/text, per-turn history, stable character spans, actual cached-token count, finish status and all errors; no post-forward source replacement or parameter tuning
claim_limits: Controlled source-backed repeated-task trajectories, not natural ten-question dialogues or a production frequency survey
Structural native-APC measurement, not a quality-preservation, ContractKV speedup, or SLO-capacity experiment
Does not authenticate the old 85.0%/2.4% or identify the old measurement cohort
